# Prooptis

> Prooptis (Prooptis Μονοπρόσωπη Ι.Κ.Ε. / Prooptis Single Member P.C., Greece) helps Greek businesses in any sector set up and grow commercial activity in Switzerland: company establishment coordination and commercial development (finding Swiss buyers and partners). It does not work on investors or fundraising.

Prooptis is a Greek company (GEMI 195398703000, tax ID 803365672), founded in 2026. It is based in Greece. Its team has many years of experience from working in and running businesses in Switzerland, deep familiarity with the Swiss market, business culture and procedures, and a network of contacts in Switzerland. It passes this know-how on to clients in practice and through advice. It serves Greek companies of every sector (food and beverages, industry and machinery, agricultural products and equipment, software, B2B services and others) that want to sell in or establish themselves in Switzerland. Website languages: Greek (primary) and English.

## Services

- **Establishment in Switzerland (Εγκατάσταση στην Ελβετία):** coordination of company formation and procedures; introductions to Swiss lawyers, accountants, banks and insurers; tracking of deadlines and documents; premises search (office, warehouse, shop) where needed. Legal and tax advice is given by licensed partner professionals; Prooptis coordinates.
- **Commercial development (Εμπορική ανάπτυξη):** research and mapping of Swiss buyers, distributors and partners; first contacts and successive introductions through a network of contacts in Switzerland; outreach guidance (message, presentation, follow-up); customer expansion after the first clients. No guaranteed customers.

## How it works

1. Free intro call (δωρεάν κλήση γνωριμίας)
2. Needs assessment and written plan (steps, order, partners, timeline, expected third-party costs)
3. Execution with regular updates

Pricing is given as a written proposal per project after the intro call; third-party costs are shown separately.
